column2: Description
Makes you stiff as a rock. Like you woke up on the wrong side of the bed.
Drink this and your bellow will be heard from the town over. May i recommend a lozenge too?
Gives one incredible calm and clarity, followed by crushing regret. Oddly enough only for men
Makes one incredibly active and full of energy. Something about becoming a powerhouse
Makes sunlight incredibly irritating to ones skin. But gives you razor sharp teeth.
Allows you to speak with animals in complete gibberish.
Makes vegetables taste like steak. A guilty pleasure.
Feed this to a wild animal and it shall become your friend. Maybe
Makes you feel like you can do anything. But you get visions and cravings for cranberry juice.
You can climb up steep cliffs. But only parallel to the face of the wall.
Widens your view. Great for sheperds. Not for racists
Eyes that see everything. No more blind spots. Experience having 8 eyes. Better than Gojo.
A potion beloved by all. Closes wounds and staunches bleeding. Though the after-effects are not as well-liked.
A must have for the local ladies. And the occasional unhygienic fellow.
Keeps one dry even if you jump into a pond. Water will slide right off you. But not your clothes.
Causes your body to expel all sorts of toxins.
Emit pheromones that make you irresistable to every living thing
Allows one who drinks this concotion to jump very high only once.
Allows one to see a single moment in that will occur in the future.
